controls.label: rustfmt
controls.note: Inherent to the toolchain and near-universally already clean.

controls.label: clippy
controls.note: On a legacy crate, start without -D warnings, record the count in harness.md, and ratchet. Denying warnings on arrival blocks every build.

controls.label: cargo check
controls.note: Inherent. Rust starts with the strongest computational guide of the four stacks, which is why its harnessability floor is high.

controls.label: cargo deny
controls.note: Continuous-monitoring class: catches advisories and licence drift long after the code stopped changing.
